draft: Here it is in grams. The recipe only lists cups and spoons, apart from the discard, so these are standard conversions: bread flour at 120 g per cup. For salt, use 6 g of Diamond Crystal kosher or 10 g of Morton.

data.title: Sourdough Discard Pizza Dough (grams)
ingredients: 6 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (or 10 g Morton)
200 g sourdough discard, unfed, room temp
directions: In a stand mixer with a dough hook, mix the bread flour, yeast, salt and sugar.
Add the discard. On low, slowly pour in the warm water and olive oil, then go to medium until a shaggy dough wraps the hook. Add flour or water about 10 g at a time if needed.
Knead on a lightly floured surface 2-3 min until soft, smooth and not sticky. Put in an oiled bowl, cover, and let rise 1 hour or until doubled.
Preheat the oven to 450°F. Dust two baking sheets with semolina.
Split the dough in two (about 385 g each), shape into rounds on the sheets, cover and rest 10 min.
Press each into a crust (if it springs back, rest 10 min more). Top, drizzle the crust with olive oil if you like, and bake 20-30 min.

draft:
Here's the core logic, with types and interfaces left out:

These are trimmed excerpts. I swapped a few helper bodies for named calls (`readFrom`, `cronPlan`, `extractPythonBlock`) so each tab fits on a screen. The full files are in `~/.config/relay/atomic-agents/app/src/` and in Relay main under `packages/atomic-agents`.

tabs.title: Run a job
Triggers
tabs.code:
// Runtime.ts: Runner.serve (what the background service runs)
yield* settings.serve.pipe(Effect.forkScoped)          // watch config.json

// OnEvent: subscribe to the bus, run the job on each matching event
yield* bus.subscribe.pipe(
  Stream.filter((event) => event.type === trigger.type),
  Stream.runForEach((event) => Effect.gen(function*() {
    if (!effective(component, yield* settings.current).enabled) return   // disabled: skip
    yield* run(component.id, job.id, event.data)
  })),
  Effect.forkScoped)

// Cron: re-armed live whenever config changes the enabled set or an expression
yield* settings.changes.pipe(
  Stream.map((current) => cronPlan(components, current)),   // [{component, job, cron, input}]
  Stream.changesWith(samePlan),
  Stream.switchMap((plan) => Stream.fromEffectDrain(Effect.forEach(plan, (entry) =>
    entry.input.pipe(
      Effect.flatMap((input) => run(entry.component, entry.job, input)),
      Effect.schedule(Schedule.cron(entry.cron))),
    { concurrency: "unbounded" }))),
  Stream.runDrain,
  Effect.forkScoped)

return yield* Effect.never
